say:0:1620534001:0.text: The cat is barely holding on, but it's still letting out weak cries. You use a transfiguration spell so you can understand what it's saying.
say:0:1620534001:0.source_cn: 猫很虚弱，但仍能呜咽作声。为了听懂它的意思，你使用了变形术。
say:0:1620534001:0.male: The cat is barely holding on, but it's still letting out weak cries. You use a transfiguration spell so you can understand what it's saying.
say:0:1620534001:0.female: The cat is barely holding on, but it's still letting out weak cries. You use a transfiguration spell so you can understand what it's saying.

say:3:1620534003:1.text: Did you escape too? Then don't stay here. Run! Those bad people could be back any second!
say:3:1620534003:1.source_cn: 你也是逃出来的动物吗？快走吧……那些坏人马上就要回来了！
say:3:1620534003:1.male: Did you escape too? Then don't stay here. Run! Those bad people could be back any second!
say:3:1620534003:1.female: Did you escape too? Then don't stay here. Run! Those bad people could be back any second!

choice_prompt:4:1620534003.text: Did you escape too? Then don't stay here. Run! Those bad people could be back any second!
choice_prompt:4:1620534003.source_cn: 你也是逃出来的动物吗？快走吧……那些坏人马上就要回来了！
choice_prompt:4:1620534003.male: Did you escape too? Then don't stay here. Run! Those bad people could be back any second!
choice_prompt:4:1620534003.female: Did you escape too? Then don't stay here. Run! Those bad people could be back any second!

say:5:1620534004:0.text: Wait... you don't look like one of us. That magic... are you a human? A mage?!
say:5:1620534004:0.source_cn: 你、你不像是逃出来的？刚才的魔法……难道说，你是人类魔...
say:5:1620534004:0.male: Wait... you don't look like one of us. That magic... are you a human? A mage?!
say:5:1620534004:0.female: Wait... you don't look like one of us. That magic... are you a human? A mage?!

say:6:1620534005:0.text: This place is their den. They've been rounding up animals by the dozen. Said they're shipping us off for good. No one's coming back...
say:6:1620534005:0.source_cn: 这里是坏人的老巢……他们抓了好多动物，说要全部运走，再...
say:6:1620534005:0.male: This place is their den. They've been rounding up animals by the dozen. Said they're shipping us off for good. No one's coming back...
say:6:1620534005:0.female: This place is their den. They've been rounding up animals by the dozen. Said they're shipping us off for good. No one's coming back...

say:7:1620534006:0.text: Meow... Right before I blacked out, I think I saw... some kind of mechanism over there...
say:7:1620534006:0.source_cn: 喵……刚才我快昏过去的时候，好像看到那边有道机关……
say:7:1620534006:0.male: Meow... Right before I blacked out, I think I saw... some kind of mechanism over there...
say:7:1620534006:0.female: Meow... Right before I blacked out, I think I saw... some kind of mechanism over there...

say:8:1620534007:1.source_cn: 好奇怪，现在又看不见了……

choice:4:1:2.text: The way's sealed. How'd you escape?
choice:4:1:2.source_cn: 对面是封闭的，你是怎么逃出来的？
choice:4:1:2.male: The way's sealed. How'd you escape?
choice:4:1:2.female: The way's sealed. How'd you escape?

say:9:1620534008:1.text: Really? Oh, thank goodness... They locked us up, hardly gave us any food, and kept frightening us...
say:9:1620534008:1.source_cn: 真的吗？太好了……他们把我们关在这里，不给吃的，还总是...
say:9:1620534008:1.male: Really? Oh, thank goodness... They locked us up, hardly gave us any food, and kept frightening us...
say:9:1620534008:1.female: Really? Oh, thank goodness... They locked us up, hardly gave us any food, and kept frightening us...

say:10:1620534009:1.text: I swear there was a mechanism or something! I escaped through it! I'm not making it up!
say:10:1620534009:1.source_cn: 但我真的看到那边有个机关！我非常确定！我就从那边走出来的！
say:10:1620534009:1.male: I swear there was a mechanism or something! I escaped through it! I'm not making it up!
say:10:1620534009:1.female: I swear there was a mechanism or something! I escaped through it! I'm not making it up!

say:11:1620534010:1.text: Maybe... if you used magic again, you'd be able to sense it. You've got to have some way to find it, right?
say:11:1620534010:1.source_cn: 也许……也许用魔法能感觉到？你一定有办法……
say:11:1620534010:1.male: Maybe... if you used magic again, you'd be able to sense it. You've got to have some way to find it, right?
say:11:1620534010:1.female: Maybe... if you used magic again, you'd be able to sense it. You've got to have some way to find it, right?

choice:4:2:3.text: I'm getting everyone out of here.
choice:4:2:3.male: I'm getting everyone out of here.
choice:4:2:3.female: I'm getting everyone out of here.
